headline: Weathered Expanse Churns Anew; Nevish Line Leans Colonial
war_summary: Fighting continues to concentrate in the north and centre, and the ledger of works has shifted again since the last edition. The Weathered Expanse, still the busiest district on the board, now shows two works Warden, two Colonial and five unclaimed, with fifty-seven actions in the past day and seven in the last two hours about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Spirit Watch. The Nevish Line, where the Colonials now hold six works to two for the Wardens, reports the war's heaviest hourly toll, roughly 1,246 Colonial and 1,312 Warden dead in the last hour, and forty-three actions in the day, the latest at this packet's cutoff. Linn Mercy stands at eight Colonial works, two Warden and one unclaimed; Lathair alone has drawn twenty-two actions. Mooring County remains eleven Warden works to one Colonial, but The Wind Hills saw twenty-three actions and hourly losses near 1,294 Colonial and 891 Warden. Stonecradle has stirred, six actions in two hours around World's End and The Reach. Marban Hollow has gone quiet since the small hours. Callahan's Passage, the costliest ground of the war, continues to cool. The map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, with Warden strength massed north and west.
